    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersReef village garlic prawnsPrawn skewers grilled with garlic, chilli, lime and butterHow to make it600g green prawns3 garlic cloves2 red chillies3 limes60g butterSoak 8 skewers. Crush the garlic, chop the red chillies, zest a lime and cut the rest into wedges. Melt the butter.Toss the prawns with garlic, chilli, zest and butter and thread onto skewers.Grill a couple of minutes a side until charred.Serve with lime wedges and spoon over any butter left in the pan.Tulkun tropical fruitMango, pineapple and papaya with passionfruit, lime juice and toasted coconutHow to make it2 mangoes1/2 pineapple1/2 papaya3 passionfruits2 limes3 tbsp shredded coconutToast the coconut in a dry pan.Cut the mangoes, pineapple and papaya into wedges and halve the passionfruit.Pile onto a platter, squeeze over lime juice and scatter with coconut.Chill until serving.Ilu ride sesame nori crispsThe kids riding ilu through the kelpHow to make itAs written, serves 4Nori sheets brushed with sesame oil, sprinkled with sesame seeds and salt, toasted in a dry pan until crisp and cut into strips.Brush 8 nori sheets lightly on one side with 2 tbsp sesame oil mixed with 1 tsp honey.Sprinkle with 2 tbsp sesame seeds, a pinch of chilli flakes and flaky salt.Stick 2 sheets together oiled sides out, then toast in a dry pan over medium heat for 1 minute a side, or bake at 150°C for 8 minutes, until crisp.Cut into strips with scissors and serve straight away.Tuna poke with lime and chilliLo'ak and Payakan, brothers of the reef.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsMetkayina coconut fishSnapper poached in coconut milk with lemongrass, red chilli and limeHow to make it2 stalks of lemongrass800ml coconut milk1 red chilli4 snapper fillets2 limes300g jasmine rice1 handful mixed fresh herbsBruise the lemongrass and slice the chilli.Simmer the lemongrass and chilli in the coconut milk.Add the snapper fillets and poach gently.Steam the rice.Squeeze in lime juice and serve over the rice with fresh herbs.Sully family chilli lime chickenThe Sully family settling in by the waterHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thighs marinated in lime, garlic and chilli, grilled until charred, sliced over a salad of mango, mint and red onion.Marinate 1kg chicken thigh for 1 hour with the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli, 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tbsp oil.Grill over high heat 5 to 6 minutes a side until charred and cooked through, then rest.Toss 2 diced mangoes with a thinly sliced red onion, mint, coriander, lime juice and a pinch of salt.Slice the chicken over the salad.SweetsLagoon coconut puddingCoconut milk set with gelatine in glasses, topped with diced mangoHow to make it800ml coconut milk100g caster sugar4 gelatine sheets2 mangoes3 passionfruitsSoak the gelatine sheets in cold water. Dice the mangoes.Warm the coconut milk with sugar until dissolved.Squeeze the gelatine and stir in.Pour into glasses and chill until set.Top with mango and passionfruit pulp.DrinksReef coconut pineapple crushFrozen pineapple, coconut water and coconut cream blended with lime and mintHow to make it400g frozen pineapple500ml coconut water100ml coconut cream1 lime1 handful mint1 cup iceJuice the lime.Blend the pineapple, coconut water, coconut cream, lime juice, mint and ice until thick and slushy.Pour into four tall glasses and finish with a pineapple wedge and mint sprig.Iced hibiscus and limeThe way of water has no beginning.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
